title.zh: Swell Pauses swETH and rswETH Deposits and Withdrawals Amid Abnormally High Cont
title.en: Swell Pauses swETH and rswETH Deposits and Withdrawals Amid Abnormally High Cont

current_state.zh: Swell paused swETH and rswETH deposits and withdrawals after the tokens' contract exchange rates ran abnormally high, with an analyst suspecting compromised admin keys and a not-yet-executed malicious upgrade contract affecting around 2,500 ETH.
